_comment: The agent's mandate: the boundaries it operates within, held outside the agent so it can be adjusted without redeploying. Tiers are evaluated by the policy service (packages/policy) on every set_price. changePct is |newPrice - currentPrice| / currentPrice * 100. Tier precedence (highest first): prohibited -> approve -> notify -> autonomous.

approve.description: Beyond +/-15%, flagged SKUs, or premium categories

prohibited.description: Hard-blocked; no override path in the demo
rules: price change during active promotion without promo-manager approval
